relations.basis: Atlas explicitly identifies East/West as Bar-Adon’s Twin pair; landscape photographs show the paired-mouth outcrop.
relations.limit: Cave-complex identity; no registered historical mouth station or ancient threshold.

relations.basis: Bar-Adon describes a closed single-level passage, 35 m long and 4 m wide on average; atlas East is 35 m, with an unbranched narrowing passage. The atlas establishes identity of the aggregate pair.
relations.limit: Morphological inference without a labelled historical station tie. The 4 m average width was not independently remeasured.

relations.basis: Bar-Adon describes a multilevel cavity with the higher innermost part open to the sky and a tall narrow inward shaft. Atlas West is multilevel, with a front opening, roof opening and internally connected lower passage.
relations.limit: Internal topology supports identity. Current floors and total surveyed length do not establish ancient thresholds or a historical station datum.

relations.basis: Both describe a separate northeastern-facing northern cave extending southwest. Interior photographs show a corresponding tall jagged aperture and stepped roof outline; the broad plan shape agrees.
relations.limit: No explicit cross-publication name or station join. No VE/VW-to-Malham point, coordinate, elevation or ancient-mouth transfer.

non_equivalences.reason: Bar-Adon’s northern cavity belongs to the East/West pair; atlas North is a third cave.

non_equivalences.a: VJRI northern cave floor or datum
non_equivalences.reason: Different cave and unregistered excavation/ancient levels.

opening_count.state: Malham 2011 survey, published in 2015; roof aperture date unknown
opening_count.terminology: P. 212 uses פתח קדמי ופתח נוסף בתקרה. P. 215 labels West front כניסה, West roof פתח בתקרה, and East front פתח.
opening_count.internal_branch: West lower passage joins the main passage at both ends; it does not establish an additional exterior aperture.
opening_count.prior_exposure: Bar-Adon [15] already describes the southern higher part as open to the sky. The 2015 labels clarify source/coding and do not supply independent field corroboration.

registration_limits: Bar-Adon’s locator 1937/1293 is not a surveyed mouth point.
Atlas rounded נצ״מ locators and reported −270 m retain unverified CRS, vertical datum and reference point.
VJRI coordinate header is degraded or typographically ambiguous; no normalized coordinate or elevation accepted.
Atlas p. 215 N arrow does not declare true/grid/magnetic north; VJRI p. 119 north/east axes have no stated north convention.
Developed profiles do not give true 3D spatial relations.
No published East/West interconnection is drawn; VJRI’s possible northern connection remains explicitly hypothetical.
Most of West’s approximately 8 m of sediment was removed by excavation; no ancient threshold, floor or wall phase established.
next_observation: An original cave-labelled field survey or level sheet tying a named historical mouth/station to an ancient threshold and wall phase. For Qetorit, first obtain a VE/VW-to-Malham station registration.
